'''Merym''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[White Ajah]]. She is only mentioned in passing and never appears in a scene.

== Strength ==
Nothing is known about Merym's strength in the One Power.

==Activities==
She has remained loyal to the [[White Tower]] during the split.

She is one in the group of sisters that take Egwene into custody, when she was discovered blocking the harbor with ''[[cuendillar]]'' weaves.

Merym gallops off with [[Jala Bandevin]] to report to [[Elaida]] just who it is that they have captured.
